name: Broccoli

moderate.description: Larger portion, may trigger symptoms in some

siboNotes: Important: Stick to broccoli HEADS/FLORETS only - the stalks have higher FODMAP content (only 1/3 cup stalks is low FODMAP). Florets are safe up to about 2 cups before becoming moderate FODMAP.
preparationTips: Use florets, not stalks, during elimination phase
Steaming preserves nutrients and aids digestion
Roasting with olive oil adds flavor
